Name: (CP AT) Joja Free
Author: LDAnvil
Description:
Do you like the modern style of Joja furniture, but hate the Joja logo written all over it? This mod will clean up the logo on joja furniture.
Affected furniture:
[list]
[*]Joja Furniture Catalogue
[*]Joja Bed
[*]Joja Vault
[*]Joja Chair (facing up and facing down)
[*]Joja Table
[*]J Light
[*]Joja Fireplace
[*]Gray Joja Cushion
[*]Joja Cushion
[*]Stacked Joja Crates
[*]Joja Couch (facing up and facing down)
[*]Joja Crate
[*]Joja Shopping Cart
[*]Large Joja Crate
[*]Joja Cola Fridge
[*]Joja Dresser (facing up)
[*]Gray Joja Dresser (facing up)
[*]Large Joja Rug
[*]Small Joja Rug
[*]Square Joja Rug
[*]Joja Rug (horizontal and vertical)
[*]Joja Bookcase
[*]Gray Joja Bookcase
[*]Joja Lamp
[*]Joja Stool
[*]Joja End Table (facing up)
[*]Gray Joja End Table (facing up)
[*]J Sign
[*]J Painting
[*]'Morris Portrait'
[*]'Joja HQ'
[*]Decorative Joja Door
[*]Joja Wallpaper
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
- Combine wallpaper and furniture into one file.
- Remove J from the pillow.
- Add Update Key.
